caseName: First Mercantile Consumer Discount Co. v. Stefanelli
caseNameFull: First Mercantile Consumer Discount Co. v. Stefanelli

opinions.text: Treating the petition for rehearing as a motion to amend the order of this Court dated October 12, 1970 [ante, p. 808], motion granted. Order amended to read, “The appeal is dismissed for want of a final judgment.”
